sections.title: Ravio's Shop
sections.note: Rent, then buy (after the three Pendants), then a Nice upgrade from Mother Maiamai.

items.name: Bow

tiers.name: Rented
tiers.howTo: Ravio lends it free the first time, after you tell him you saw the Bow symbol at the Eastern Ruins. Later rentals cost 50 Rupees. Sheerow takes rentals back if you fall in battle.

tiers.name: Bought
tiers.howTo: Buy it from Ravio for 800 Rupees once you have the three Pendants. The first item you buy is half price.

tiers.name: Nice Bow
tiers.howTo: Bring Mother Maiamai 10 Lost Maiamai (her cave south-east of Link's House by Lake Hylia, bombed open) and let her upgrade this item. Only bought items can be upgraded.

items.notes: Rent 50, buy 800 Rupees (Zelda Wiki, Zelda Dungeon, IGN). Zelda Wiki: the first loan, before the Eastern Palace, is free, and a re-rental costs 10 Rupees until the Eastern Palace is cleared.

sections.title: Equipment
sections.note: Gear and key items; the sword, shield, mail, gloves, Lamp and Net are one row each.

items.name: Sword
items.notes: Each Master Sword upgrade doubles its power (Zelda Wiki). Two Master Ore per upgrade; see Master Ore.

tiers.name: Captain's Sword
tiers.howTo: Left at the Blacksmith's Forge by the Captain at the start; Link keeps it after the Sanctuary. Zelda Wiki calls it the Forgotten Sword.

tiers.name: Master Sword
tiers.howTo: Draw it in the Lost Woods with the three Pendants.

tiers.name: Master Sword Lv2
tiers.howTo: Bring two Master Ore to the Blacksmith in Hyrule (the Blacksmith's Forge west of Link's House).

tiers.name: Master Sword Lv3
tiers.howTo: With the Lv2 sword, talk to the Hyrule Blacksmith (who says he can do no more), then bring two more Master Ore to the Blacksmith in Lorule (Blacksmith's Forge, east of Thieves' Town).

items.name: Shield
items.notes: Like Likes can eat the plain Shield. The Hylian Shield also blocks Beamos beams and Lynel fire. Zelda Wiki's Hylian Shield page says the chest appears after beating the four Fire Wizzrobes on the first floor; its Turtle Rock page and Zelda Dungeon's walkthrough describe the B1 grate bridge.

tiers.name: Shield
tiers.howTo: Buy it for 50 Rupees at the Item Shop in Kakariko Village or at the Lakeside Item Shop (Lorule's shops sell it too).

tiers.name: Hylian Shield
tiers.howTo: In a chest in Turtle Rock, past the grate bridge outside the Big Key room on B1.

items.name: Mail
items.notes: Link starts in the Green Tunic. Each mail halves damage again.

tiers.name: Blue Mail
tiers.howTo: In the Swamp Palace (central room of B1, reached by lowering the water in the room to the south).

tiers.name: Red Mail
tiers.howTo: In Lorule Castle (4th floor: put out the two torches to show hidden ledges, then use the Lamp).

tiers.name: Power Glove
tiers.howTo: From Rosso at his house north of Kakariko Village. Lifts small rocks.

tiers.name: Titan's Mitt
tiers.howTo: In the Desert Palace (central north room of the first floor). Lifts large rocks.

items.name: Pegasus Boots
items.howTo: Wall Merge behind the Shady Guy in Kakariko and step out to scare him; he gives you the boots.

items.name: Zora's Flippers
items.howTo: From Queen Oren once you return her Smooth Gem (200 Rupees from the Street Merchant in Kakariko).

items.name: Ravio's Bracelet
items.howTo: Ravio gives it to Link when he moves in after the Sanctuary. It wakes up after Yuga's attack in the Eastern Palace and lets Link Wall Merge.

items.name: Lamp
items.notes: The Treacherous Tower is in Lorule's Death Mountain, where the Tower of Hera stands in Hyrule.

tiers.name: Lamp
tiers.howTo: In the first chest of the secret passage from the Graveyard to the Sanctuary.

tiers.name: Super Lamp
tiers.howTo: Clear the Treacherous Tower's Advanced course (50 floors, 300 Rupees) for the first time. Eight times the damage.

items.name: Bug-Catching Net
items.notes: The Net also returns Yuga Ganon's energy balls.

tiers.name: Bug-Catching Net
tiers.howTo: From the Bee Guy in his house near the middle of Kakariko Village. Zelda Dungeon's walkthrough buys a Bottle first; no source says one is required.

tiers.name: Super Net
tiers.howTo: Clear the Treacherous Tower's Advanced course a second time. Eight times the damage.

items.name: Hint Glasses
items.howTo: Talk to the Fortune-Teller. They show Hint Ghosts, who give hints for Play Coins.

items.name: Bell
items.howTo: Irene gives it to you at the bridge east of Link's House, after the Eastern Palace. Ring it to fly to any Weather Vane you have saved at in the world you're in.

items.name: Pouch
items.area: Haunted Grove (south of the Blacksmith's Forge)
items.howTo: Pick it up from the tree stump in the middle of the Haunted Grove after the Blacksmith's Wife asks about Gulley. Lets you set an item on X as well as Y.

items.name: Bee Badge
items.howTo: Give the Bee Guy a Golden Bee in a Bottle. Golden Bees hide in bushes and tall grass, or can be bought (9,999 Rupees in Lorule's Item Shops). Bees then fight for Link instead of stinging him.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki's Golden Bee page also mentions a man in the woods round the Lost Woods selling one for 888 Rupees; not confirmed elsewhere.

items.name: Stamina Scroll
items.howTo: In the Ice Ruins, pull the lever in B2's central room to remove the platform above the chest on the east platform of B3's southern room. Makes the energy gauge bigger.

sections.title: Master Ore
sections.note: Four chunks; two per Master Sword upgrade.

items.name: Master Ore (Thieves' Hideout)
items.howTo: In the flooded basement, stand on one of the two floor switches in the south-west and have the Thief Girl stand on the other. Run down the hallway that opens to the chest.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #1.

items.name: Master Ore (Philosopher's Cave)
items.area: Lorule Graveyard (cave under the north-east corner)
items.howTo: Take the Fissure inside Hyrule's Sanctuary to Lorule and go east to the graveyard. Lift the large rock in its north-east corner and take the stairs. Solve the passage (switch under the pots, small key, three red Eyegores, lever) and Wall Merge to the big chest.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #4. Needs: Titan's Mitt. Zelda Wiki says the cave sits where Hyrule's Sanctuary is.

items.name: Master Ore (Dark Palace)
items.howTo: North of the room with six windows, set a Bomb by the lower switch, ride the lift up with the other switch and stand by the north wall: when the Bomb hits the switch the wall turns and carries Link to the chest.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #3. Needs: Bombs.

items.name: Master Ore (Skull Woods)
items.area: Skull Woods, Lorule (north-west room, first floor)
items.howTo: In the room with the two eye statues (same room as the Big Key), drop through the hidden hole in the woods onto the south-east ledge, then Wall Merge to the ledge with the big chest.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #2.

items.name: Street Merchant
items.howTo: Buy it from the Street Merchant in the middle of Kakariko Village for 100 Rupees.

items.name: Bird Lover under the bridge
items.area: Under the bridge east of Link's House, Hyrule
items.howTo: Swim up the river from Lake Hylia to under the big bridge east of Link's House and tell the Bird Lover you like birds.
items.notes: Needs: Zora's Flippers.

items.name: Bouldering Guy
items.area: Hyrule Death Mountain (ledge off the lava cave)
items.howTo: Fish the Letter in a Bottle out of the water east of the House of Gales. The Milk Bar owner in Kakariko fills it with Premium Milk. Take it through the lava cave east of the Tower of Hera (south from the Lynels' platform, then the left of the three platforms), Wall Merge outside to the stranded Bouldering Guy and give him the milk.
items.notes: Needs: Zora's Flippers, Hookshot, Power Glove. Zelda Dungeon and Zelda Universe put the letter east of the House of Gales / Lake Hylia, IGN east of Lake Hylia, Zelda Wiki in the river east of Hyrule Castle.

items.name: Vacant House
items.area: Vacant House, Lorule (where Link's House is in Hyrule)
items.howTo: Bomb the back (north) wall of the Vacant House south of Lorule Castle and open the chest inside.
items.notes: Needs: Bombs.

items.name: Great Rupee Fairy
items.area: Great Fairy Fountain, Lorule (north-west of the Bomb Flower Store)
items.howTo: Blow up the cracked boulder north-west of the Bomb Flower Store south of Thieves' Town with the Big Bomb Flower (200 Rupees). Throw 3,000 Rupees in all into the fountain, 50 or 200 at a time, over any number of visits.
items.notes: She hands out fairies as the total grows (IGN).
